{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast
# Note: the values are already in format '1234.56', no commas to remove
# But still, cast to float
print("Converting revenue from string to float...")
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders and QA orders
# QA orders: revenue == 999999.99
# But we already saw there are 0 such rows
# Refunded orders: status == 'refunded'
completed_orders = df[(df['status'] == 'completed')]

print(f"Number of completed orders: {len(completed_orders)}")

# Check channel distribution
print("Channel distribution:")
print(completed_orders['channel'].value_counts())

# Check customer_segment distribution by channel
print("\nCustomer segment distribution by channel:")
print(completed_orders.groupby('channel')['customer_segment'].value_counts())"}
